task: Finish PR #2183: fix(linkedin): FI/SV posts via ugcPosts UTF-8 + vault-loaded social credentials
prompt:
Bring PR #2183 ("fix(linkedin): FI/SV posts via ugcPosts UTF-8 + vault-loaded social credentials", branch fix/linkedin-scandinavian-utf8) to mergeable. Do not change what the PR is for.
1) git fetch origin && git merge origin/main — resolve every conflict keeping both sides' intent; regenerate lockfiles/generated files with the repo's tooling, never by hand.
2) gh pr checks 2183 and gh pr view 2183 --comments: fix every failing check and every review finding that is a real bug; for optional nits, fix only if trivial.
3) Run the checks CI would run for the changed files (npx tsc --noEmit, related vitest, prettier --check).
4) Commit and git push origin fix/linkedin-scandinavian-utf8 (a merge commit, never a rebase or force-push).
5) If something needs a human decision (content, pricing, policy), write it as a PR comment with gh pr comment and stop.

checks.name: origin/main is merged in
checks.run: git fetch -q origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD

checks.name: no failing PR checks (except the Copilot reviewer app, which fails on every PR)
checks.run: out=$(gh pr checks 2183 2>&1 | grep -v copilot-pull-request-reviewer); echo "$out" | tail -15; ! echo "$out" | grep -qiE '\bfail(ed|ure)?\b'

checks.name: GitHub sees it as mergeable
checks.run: m=$(gh pr view 2183 --json mergeable -q .mergeable); echo "mergeable=$m"; [ "$m" = MERGEABLE ]
